title: iNaturalist names the reference DB knows under another name
description: recipes/inat_names.json, shared by every recipe with the order source inat. iNaturalist renames and splits taxa before FishBase and SeaLifeBase do; an observation under the new name would then resolve to nothing and the species would silently drop out of a deck. An entry maps such an iNaturalist name to the reference-DB name its observations belong to, and the counts of both add up. Only a rename (TaxonSwap), or a split whose new species takes over a population the reference-DB species still covers, belongs here; a newly described species without such a counterpart, or anything in doubt, stays out.

referenceDb.description: The name the reference DB knows, which takes the observations.

change.description: swap: the same taxon renamed; split: a population of the reference-DB taxon now a species of its own.

reason.description: Why the observations belong to the reference-DB species, in one or two sentences; for a split, where the new species lives and that the reference-DB species still covers it.

evidence.description: The iNaturalist taxon change that says so.
